8.title: No Condemnation, No Separation
8.text: There is therefore now no condemnation to them which are in Christ Jesus, who walk not after the flesh, but after the Spirit. The law could not save us, weak as it was through the flesh; God sending his own Son in the likeness of sinful flesh has condemned sin in the flesh. The Spirit of adoption gives us liberty to cry, 'Abba, Father.' The whole creation groans, but we are saved by hope, and the Spirit himself maketh intercession for us with groanings which cannot be uttered. All things work together for good to them that love God. Whom he foreknew, he predestinated, called, justified, glorified — the chain unbroken. If God be for us, who can be against us? Nothing in all creation shall be able to separate us from the love of God which is in Christ Jesus our Lord.

12.title: Living Sacrifices
12.text: Paul beseeches the brethren by the mercies of God to present their bodies a living sacrifice, holy, acceptable unto God — your reasonable service. Be not conformed to this world, but be ye transformed by the renewing of your mind. Christ's people are one body of many members, with differing gifts to be used in proportion to faith. Let love be without dissimulation. Bless them which persecute you. Recompense to no man evil for evil. As much as lieth in you, live peaceably with all men. Be not overcome of evil, but overcome evil with good — this is the cross-shaped life of every believer.
